mapper.select: SELECT connection.id AS connection_id, connection.version, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_credential credential WHERE credential.platform_provider_connection_id = connection.id AND credential.credential_purpose = 'INFERENCE_API_KEY') AS credential_configured, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_credential credential WHERE credential.platform_provider_connection_id = connection.id AND credential.credential_purpose = 'DISCOVERY_ACCESS_KEY_ID') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_credential credential WHERE credential.platform_provider_connection_id = connection.id AND credential.credential_purpose = 'DISCOVERY_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')) AS discovery_credentials_configured, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_publication publication WHERE publication.connection_id = connection.id AND publication.connection_revision = connection.version AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED') AS published FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection WHERE connection.id IN #{id}
